mentions.name: PatchPal
mentions.description: Open-source agentic coding assistant written in Python that supports both local and cloud models and is easy to modify and extend for custom workflows. It can be accessed through a terminal as well as a Python API/REPL, with recent releases adding custom tools, agent skills, and built-in support for Ralph Wiggum loops.
mentions.problem: Existing agentic coding assistants (Claude Code, Aider, Opencode, Codex, etc.) didn't offer support for both local and cloud models together with easy modification and extension for custom workflows.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on https://github.com/wiseprobe/patchpal , an open-source agentic coding assistant in Python.
